headline: Executive order directing federal agencies to take steps to increase competition and give consumers and workers better information.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order tells federal agencies to look for ways to increase competition in the economy. It also aims to give consumers and workers more information to help them make choices. No summary was provided, so the specific steps and requirements are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are directed to take steps that support competition and better inform consumers and workers.
The order aims to give them better information about the products and services they buy.
The order aims to give them better information, likely about jobs and the labor market.
They may face changes in federal rules or actions meant to increase competition.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 15, 2016; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
